name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: At Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII suspects sabotage and sends volatile powder north for examination. A courier must carry it through the perilous Wetlands to demolition expert Ashlan Stonesmirk at Dun Modr.

sections.title: A Powder of Ill Intent
sections.body: A strange-smelling powder came from a suspicious barrel near the Stonewrought Dam’s eastern ramp, where Hinderweir had spotted Dark Iron sappers. Disturbances around the dam have put the chief engineer on alert. He suspects the powder is a refined explosive meant to shatter dwarven masonry, but the dam has no specialized equipment to test it. Before he draws a firm conclusion, he wants a military demolitionist to examine the sample.

sections.title: The Road North
sections.body: The journey leads through the Algaz Gate and down into the sodden lowlands of the Wetlands. Hostile wildlife, aggressive dragonkin, and Dark Iron infiltrators make the route dangerous. Hinderweir urges travelers to stay on the cobbled road to Dun Modr, a pillaged dwarven town at the southern approach to the Thandol Span. An Ironforge regiment still guards the town.

sections.title: The Blast Expert of Dun Modr
sections.body: Ashlan Stonesmirk is the regiment’s resident master of high explosives at Dun Modr, on the front line of northern Khaz Modan. Decades of concussive blasts have left him half-deaf, but his keen eye and nose confirm Hinderweir’s fears: the compound is a specialized demolition charge. Its presence points to an orchestrated plot against the heart of dwarven engineering.

faq.q: What is the strange smelling powder?
faq.answer: The strange-smelling powder is an alchemical explosive charge collected near the Stonewrought Dam. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII suspects saboteurs mean to breach the dam walls with it.

faq.q: Why send the powder all the way to Dun Modr?
faq.answer: Dun Modr houses the Ironforge military contingent defending the Thandol Span, including Ashlan Stonesmirk. He is a veteran explosives expert with the technical knowledge to identify specialized blast compounds.
Ashlan Stonesmirk is stationed at Dun Modr’s military camp, in the far northern Wetlands just south of the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why does Hinderweir warn to stick to the road?
faq.answer: Hinderweir warns couriers to stay on the road descending from the Algaz Gate because the Wetlands beyond are infested with hostile beasts, raptors, gnolls, and Dark Iron saboteurs. Off-road travel is extremely dangerous.

faq.q: Who is sabotaging the Stonewrought Dam?
faq.answer: The explosives belong to the Dark Iron dwarves, who seek to undermine Bronzebeard infrastructure and collapse the Stonewrought Dam, drowning the valleys below.

faq.q: Why is Ashlan Stonesmirk hard of hearing?
faq.answer: Years of frontline work as a military sapper and explosives specialist have left Ashlan with chronic ringing in his ears and severe hearing loss caused by blast concussions.

angles.text: The Stonewrought Dam is one of the crowning jewels of Bronzebeard engineering. A plot to shatter its masonry threatens the pride and safety of all Khaz Modan.
Identifying high-grade explosive residues takes a sapper’s practiced eye. Even mundane powders can reveal an enemy saboteur’s technical sophistication.
The highway through Loch Modan and the Wetlands is a critical military lifeline between Ironforge and the northern Alliance holdings across the Thandol Span.
